name: Thai-Style Soba Noodle Soup (Khao Soi) with Bok Choy & Snap Peas

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch cilantro
12 baby bok choy
1 ½ (227 g) pkgs sugar snap peas
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Peel and roughly chop ginger. Peel garlic. Place both in a blender.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems. Add cilantro stems and half of the leaves to the blender. (Reserve remaining leaves for later use.)
Add coconut milk, chili-garlic sauce, and spices to the blender. Blend on high until mixture is smooth, scraping down the sides of the blender with a spatula as needed.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (398 ml) cans coconut milk
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tbsp curry powder
1 tbsp coriander, ground
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add coconut mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and roughly chop bok choy. Place in a large bowl.
Halve snap peas. Add to the bowl with the bok choy.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Once the coconut mixture has thickened, add broth, sugar, soy sauce, and fish sauce to the pot. Whisk to combine and bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
2129 ml chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp fish sauce

instructions.primary_message: Once the broth is boiling, add veggies to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until just softened, about 3 minutes.
Add soba noodles to the pot and cook until tender, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Remove from heat.
To serve, divide broth, veggies, and noodles between bowls; sprinkle with reserved cilantro and sesame seeds. Enjoy!
